requirements.statement: Allow a customer to browse the currently published menu without creating an account.
Allow a customer to submit a pickup order without creating an account.
Collect customer name and telephone number for web and telephone orders without requiring account registration.
Accept pickup orders only in the first operational MVP.
Offer the earliest feasible pickup opportunity and feasible scheduled pickup opportunities calculated from the final basket and current operational constraints.
Confirm an order only after final revalidation of ordering mode, service hours, pickup capacity, publication, availability, and applicable stock.
In manual-review mode, allow authorised staff to accept the requested pickup time, reject the order, or propose a feasible alternative pickup time.
Allow authorised staff to cancel an order and record the applicable reason.
Do not provide general customer self-service cancellation in the first operational MVP.
Preserve accepted-order price, product commitment, and capacity admission despite later catalog or capacity changes.
Route an accepted order that can no longer be fulfilled as confirmed to operational attention without silently changing or cancelling it.
Allow authorised staff to enter telephone and in-person orders through the same operational order flow used by web orders.
Record each order origin as WEB, PHONE, or IN_PERSON.
Allow authorised staff to switch online ordering among automatic acceptance, manual review, and paused modes.
Allow a customer using private tracking to accept or decline a staff-proposed alternative pickup time within the configured response window.
Allow a customer using private tracking to reject an important revised pickup estimate and route silence or rejection to staff attention according to the validated rule.
Provide authenticated staff access to an operational kitchen queue and prevent public access to that queue.
Allow authorised staff to progress orders through the approved lifecycle while preventing duplicate or invalid transitions.
Keep a newly received order visibly highlighted until staff explicitly acknowledge it.
Provide an audible alert and persistent visible indication for a newly received order under validated kitchen conditions.
Display connection status, identify stale data, and prevent state-changing actions while disconnected.
